trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyDescription_one: This permanently deletes {{count}} vehicle and its refuelings. It cannot be undone.
trash.emptyDescription_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} vehicles and their refuelings. It cannot be undone.

trash.emptyPartial_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} items you are allowed to delete; items you may only restore stay in the trash. It cannot be undone.
trash.refuelingDescription_one: This permanently deletes {{count}} refuelling. It cannot be undone.
trash.refuelingDescription_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} refuelings. It cannot be undone.

trash.expenseDescription_other: This permanently deletes {{count}} expenses. It cannot be undone.

admin.title: Administration

admin.editDescription: Changing the e-mail changes how this user signs in.
admin.passwordDescription: The user is signed out everywhere and must use this password from now on.

admin.purgeWarning: Their vehicles and all their logs, expenses and charts are deleted for good, including the trash.
admin.moveGrantsNote: Sharing moves along: the other user takes over who may see this user's data, and whose data this user could see.

photos.hint: {{n}} of {{max}} photos. JPEG, PNG or WebP; large photos are made smaller automatically.

reading.filled: Read from the photo; check it.
reading.announce: Filled in from the photo: {{fields}}. Check them before saving.
reading.nothing: Nothing could be read from the photos.
reading.nothingFilled: Nothing could be filled in from the photos.

issues.UNRECOGNISED: The photo could not be recognised as an odometer or a receipt.
issues.NOTHING_LEGIBLE: Nothing on the photo could be read.
issues.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: {{field}}: the value on the photo was not in a form the app can use, so it was not filled in.
issues.OUT_OF_RANGE: {{field}}: the value on the photo is not believable, so it was not filled in.
issues.ODOMETER_BELOW_LATEST: The photo shows an odometer reading that is lower than the last one logged{{last}}, so it was not filled in.
issues.ODOMETER_TOO_FAR_ABOVE: The photo shows an odometer reading far above the last one logged{{last}}, more than a vehicle covers between two logs, so it was not filled in.
issues.ODOMETER_FAR_ABOVE: The photo shows an odometer reading much higher than the last one logged{{last}}, so it was not filled in: check it.
issues.DATE_TOO_OLD: The photo shows a date more than three years ago, so it was not filled in.
issues.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The photo shows a date in the future, so it was not filled in.
issues.AMOUNTS_DO_NOT_ADD: {{field}}: the litres and the price per litre on the photo do not add up to the total, so it was not filled in.
issues.NO_CONFIDENCE: {{field}}: the photo could be read here, but not reliably enough to fill it in.
issues.UNSURE: {{field}}: the photo could be read here, but not reliably enough to fill it in.

reading.waiting: Leave it empty: it is filled in from the photo after saving.

callout.AWAITING_PHOTOS: Its photos are still being read: the values left empty are filled in from them.
callout.NEEDS_REVIEW: Some values were read from its photos (marked below). Check them and save.
callout.INCOMPLETE: Its photos did not show every value. Fill in what is missing and save.
